This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 4, Original)]] (version 2 of 3). The current text is [[Tarkin (V) (Remastered)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 4, Original)]]): Virtual Set 4 release<ref name="eh1351-tarkin-0">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/set-4-officially-released/ Players Committee Set 4 launch announcement, 29 June 2016]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160702011718id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/set-4-officially-released/ Internet Archive].</ref>. First published 29 June 2016. Text: “[Pilot] 2. When deployed, may draw cards from Reserve Deck until you have up to six cards in hand. During battle, if present with two other ISB agents, may cancel an opponent's just drawn destiny.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Players Committee Appendix A replacement<ref name="eh1351-tarkin-1">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1058171#p1058171 Players Committee Appendix A replacement, effective 3 September 2016].</ref>. Dated effective 3 September 2016 (Appendix A replacement); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was the PC-E1 version of Tarkin (V) first published|section=On what day were the early Virtual Modern card versions first published?}} The Set 4 slip sheet captured 5 July 2017 prints this text with the “E” mark. Text: “[Pilot] 2. When deployed, may draw cards from Reserve Deck until you have up to six cards in hand. During battle, if present with two ISB agents, may cancel an opponent's just drawn destiny.” '''What changed:''' game text: words removed: “other”; destiny none → 1; the lore now reads “Imperial Governor of the Seswenna Sector. Conceived and implemented the Death Star project. A leader in the effort to crush the Rebellion.”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Tarkin (V) (Remastered)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-tarkin-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/tarkin.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 commit e8445f0] (1 June 2022).</ref>. First published 1 June 2022. Text: “[Pilot] 2. When deployed, may draw cards from Reserve Deck until you have up to six cards in hand. During battle, if present with two ISB agents, may cancel an opponent's just drawn destiny.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”); the margin title lost its uniqueness dot. It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.
